kana.description: Flashcard game to learn hiragana and katakana: a level journey with stars, a timed challenge and an endless mode. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
kana.close: Close and go back to the home page
kana.intro: Learn the Japanese alphabets: see the kana and say how it reads.

kana.journeyHelp: Each level needs 70% correct answers (★) to unlock the next one. ★★ = 90% · ★★★ = no mistakes. This progress is saved and never lost.
kana.tableHelp: In the traditional order: each row is a consonant and each column a vowel.

libras.description: Flashcard game to learn the Libras (Brazilian Sign Language) manual alphabet and numbers: a 3D (WebGL) character makes the signs, with a level journey with stars, a time attack and an endless mode. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
libras.close: Close and go back to the home page
libras.intro: Learn the Libras (Brazilian Sign Language) manual alphabet and numbers: read the sign or find the sign for each letter.
libras.lefty: I am left-handed: mirror the hands
libras.tableHelp: Every sign, for reference. The pink dots show the path of the movement. On the game card, drag to rotate the camera. The character is simplified: also check a Libras dictionary.
libras.credits: Signs measured from the animations of VLibras, the Brazilian Federal Government accessibility suite (free software, LGPL-3.0 license).
